notes.title: Officially announcing our sweetest creation — High Times! 🍩
notes.content:
Hey gang,

We're super excited to publicly unveil our latest and sweetest creation: [b]High Times[/b].

In a world where you can get high with no consequences, the hardest drug to get over are your exes. In this (anti) dating sim about drugs and donuts, you'll manage a café, serve special donuts that get customers high, and live out the ultimate fantasy — getting closure with your exes!

[b]Wishlist on Steam:[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251220]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251220[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28198396/db16936e5220834aa457fb733c1ae525916268c9.png[/img]
[h3]ABOUT THE GAME[/h3]

Welcome to The Hotbox!

It's the year 2069 (nice!), and miracles have been made in the name of science. The greatest of them all? Drugs are now totally safe to consume!

Set in the fictional world of San Mazo — [i]which is totally not a rip off of LA[/i] — you're a Mood Confectioner (a fancy term for someone who bakes drugs into sweets) who must turn your boss' café, The Hotbox, into the hottest place in town or get fired. That isn’t the end of your problems, though — the exes whom you've ghosted are back in town and they all have a bone to pick with you.

Good luck, heartbreaker!

[b]Game Genre:[/b] Simulation, Casual
[b]Story Genre:[/b] Comedy, Slice of Life, Drama, Romance
[b]Length:[/b] 8-10 hours, depending on reading speed (single playthrough)
[b]Platforms:[/b] PC (Steam); Mobile (iOS/Android); Consoles (Nintendo Switch)
[b]Languages:[/b] English, Simplified & Traditional Chinese (please stay tuned for more languages!)
[b]Intended Release:[/b] 2024

Manage your own Mood Café and serve special donuts that get the high times rolling! Know your clients, find out their tastes, and make those donuts that they’ve been craving for!

Surprise! Your exes are back to complicate things. They’ve got their own baggage, but you’re a Mood Confectioner, not a bellboy.

notes.title: Our next game: Saint Maker!

Dear gang,

We'd like to officially announce our upcoming game, "[b]Saint Maker[/b]", a religious psychological horror visual novel.

While attending a religious recollection, Holly Beltran experiences strange hauntings throughout the convent. At night, broken faced statues and whispered prayers haunt Holly’s dreams — before the recollection is over, Holly may have to face more than her own demons to come out alive.

notes.title: v1.0.9 is live!!
notes.content:
Hey gang! Sorry for the wait, but we're happy to announce that v1.0.9 is officially live! \o/

[h1] Patch Notes: [/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Relationship Balancing.[/b][spoiler]Increased Hannah/Luke relationship from +1 to +2 when 'You'll be a great father' is selected in Chapter 2.[/spoiler]
[*][b]VA Mismatch.[/b] All reported inconsistencies between the voice acting and the in-game text are fixed! 
[*][b]Branch tree nodes.[/b] All reported bugs regarding the branch tree nodes are fixed! Theoretically, you should be able to unlock all the nodes in Chapter 6 and 7 and get those achievements!
[*][b]Gallery bugs.[/b] All gallery/image related bugs are now fixed! Excess locked CGs, item sprites, etc. are gone, and the CGs that have a flashback effect should now be displaying correctly!
[*][b] Save files.[/b] We have implemented a new fix that would hopefully prevent users from losing their progress when the saving process is disrupted. Though rare, we will still be keeping an eye for these types of reports. If you continue to encounter this problem (I sure hope not!), please don't hesitate to approach us!
[*][b]General polishing of the whole game.[/b]
[/list]

[h1] What we're doing now [/h1]

Assuming everything goes well with v1.0.9 and there are no major problems, our next patch will include the narrative fixes of the full game (courtesy of our wonderful editing team; thank you to all the players who volunteered! ^^), plus the long-awaited Music Room!! Watch out for our future announcements! We're so excited! ♡♡

----
That's it for today's update! If you're enjoying the game, please don't forget to leave us a review! ^^ Thank you so much for playing The Letter! ♡

notes.title: We haven't forgotten about you! :)
notes.content:
Hi gang! Just a short announcement to let you all know that we're still working on the game. :D v1.0.9 is still coming; we're just taking our time to make sure there are no game-breaking bugs that will come along once it's released. We learned our lesson from v1.0.7, after all! :P

Here's what we've been doing these past few weeks:
[list]
[*] Save files. Despite the fix we've implemented before, a few players still lose their save files/progress when their PC improperly shuts down. When this happens, our saving process is disrupted, causing it to become corrupted. Our lead programmer is working on another fix for this as we speak, and it will be released in v1.0.9. This is a rare bug, but if you're one of the few who's been affected, please send an email to john@yangyangmobile.com so we can help you recover your save files. :)
[*] Grammar check/polishing of Chapter 6.
[*] VA bug fixing of Chapters 5, 6 and 7. The text should match what's being said by the actors.
[*] Bug fixing of branch tree nodes.
[*] Bug fixing of gallery/image related bugs.
[*] A few relationship balancing.
[*] And several other bug fixes and polishing of the game in general.
[/list]
Moving forward, reward fulfillment for our backers is also underway:
[list]
[*] Mobile version of the game (both iOS and Android).
[*] Artbook and soundtrack.
[*] Special content.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28198396/e135d2f75c6d1565fd600198a4e6e9656a727154.png[/img]

[h1] CALL TO ARMS! [/h1]
We're blessed to have very supportive players! ♡ We've been receiving messages from some you, offering to help us check the game's grammar and narrative. We're eternally grateful, and if you're an active member of our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/dACNN8P]Discord[/url], I already mentioned there that we will soon release the game's raw files to all those who are willing to re-read all 700k words of it. XD

For now, if you're interested in joining our community-based Editing Team, please fill up this short survey: 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd5KDyejGHJvjddLnaZJoqVTb0CefxZ0rcWonzUzN77s-DMrA/viewform

Once we're ready to distribute the files, we'll let you know through Discord and/or via email. As a token of our appreciation, all volunteers will be added in the game's credits! ♡

[h1] What about Translations? [/h1]
Just like editing, we've been receiving offers from our players to translate the game into different languages! Thank you all so much for offering your time to make The Letter an even better game, and we'll reach out to you again as soon as editing is done! :)

---
That's it for today's update! If you're enjoying the game, please don't forget to leave us a review! ^^ Thank you so much for playing The Letter! ♡

notes.title: [Important] Patch Notes for v1.0.8
notes.content:
Hello gang! We are aware of the various UI problems caused by the latest patch (v1.0.7). We are pushing the fix for this as we speak, and v1.0.8 should be available anytime now. 

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience this has caused. We are currently optimizing several of the game's systems for better performance, and in the process, accidentally nicked the wrong parts. We will be more careful next time. 

[b] Patch Notes for v1.0.8 [/b]
[list]
[*] [b] Fixed various UI problems [/b], such as: (a) Extras redirecting to Gallery. (b) Unclickable choices. (c) Messed-up journal layout. (d) And several other weird UI problems that seem to fix itself when the game is restarted.
[*] [b] Re-polished the narrative of Chapter 1. [/b] All reported grammar mistakes for Chapter 1 here on Steam and Discord should be fixed. We also rephrased some parts that are stilted, so hopefully they sound more natural now. Please let us know if there's anything else you find odd!
[*] [b] Bug Fixing of Chapter 6. [/b] All reported VA mismatch, branch tree nodes not unlocking, and bugs for Chapter 6 should be fixed! However, there are still some lines that don't have VA. We'll get to them soon! If we missed something, please let us know so we can correct them!
[*] [b] Relationship Balancing. [/b] [spoiler] Increased Isabella/Rebecca relationship from +1 to +2 when 'This cold caught up with me' & 'Is this why you didn't go home last night?' were selected in Chapter 5. [/spoiler] 
[/list]
[h1] What to expect for v1.0.9 [/h1]

We have noticed several issues regarding the game's CGs/BGs, so please expect another patch from us soon. These issues include unobtainable Epilogue CGs, all CGs/BGs that have a vignette/flashback effect not displaying, and other Gallery-related bugs. 

v1.0.9 might come a few days from now. Please be a little more patient with us as we continue to squash these pesky bugs! =)

Thank you so much!

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.0.5 + Release Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
He'ya gang! Sorry for the late announcement, but here are the patch notes for [b] v.1.0.5 [/b]!
[list]
[*] Fixed all reported branch tree nodes that were not unlocking.
[*] Fixed a couple of mismatched VA lines.
[*] Fixed a few dangling italic tags.
[*] Fixed an achievement that was impossible to unlock due to a wrong condition.
[*] Fixed a couple of wrong conditions at Chapter 7 (both text and branch tree).
[*] Improved the N scene at Chapter 1.
[*] Implemented a handle that prevents the game from getting stuck at the Disclaimer page if your PC/device improperly shuts down.
[*] Implemented 4k HD resolution 2560x1440 & 3840x2160, although this is still in beta. Please let us know if you find any problems with these resolutions!
[*] Implemented a fix that causes the save data to be wiped when you exit the game (only affects new players). v1.0.5 shouldn't have this problem anymore, but in case you want to recover your old save files, please e-mail john@yangyangmobile.com and we'll help you sort it out!
[/list]
[h1] Future Fixes [/h1]
Here are the things we're continuously improving, and might take some time to be 100% resolved:
[list]
[*] Grammar and VA mismatch with the text.
[*] Dangling italic tags.
[*] Lines that don't have VA. 
[*] Branch tree nodes not unlocking (only a few left!)
[/list]
[h1] Release Demo (Chapter 1) Now Available! [/h1]
For those who are still on the fence if they should buy the game, we have released the full Chapter 1 as a demo for you to try! Hopefully you'll like it! ^^

[h1] What about Music Room? [/h1]
We plan to release a soundtrack DLC of the game in the near future, and the Music Room will unlock if you purchase the DLC. We will also provide an MP3 or WAV (not sure yet) version, so you can also listen to it even if you're not playing the game :)

Backers who pledged for Digital Deluxe and above will receive the soundtrack DLC as part of their campaign rewards!

[h1][b] THANK YOU! [/b][/h1]
Before we end this update, we just want to say a [b]BIG THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who purchased the game, wrote reviews, reported bugs and supported us in general! :) We wouldn't have gotten this far without you all, and we're really glad you enjoyed the game despite the occasional bugs! Reading the positive reviews make us very happy, like you have no idea. XD

So... thank you!!

notes.title: Big Patch Notes for v1.0.2!
notes.content:
Hello gang!

We'll be pushing out a new patch today [b] (v.1.0.2) [/b] that addresses the following things:

[h1] Polishing & Proof-reading [/h1]

We are replaying the entire game and we're adding some more polishing/proof-reading to every scene. Because Chapters 6 and 7 are SO HUGE with lots and lots of combinations, the extra pass of polishing might take some time (if not months), so please expect frequent patches from us!

[h1] Branching Tree & Loading Save Files [/h1]

We are aware that the branching trees of 6 and 7 are lagging. That's because they're super long. To begin with, we ourselves didn't expect the game to blow up like this, so the system was unable to handle it properly.

Our programmers have currently implemented a fix in this patch. Loading saved files should be faster now. But the compromise is opening the branch tree for the first time will be a bit slow (might take a couple of seconds). But once you re-open them it should be fast already. :) Switching from one branch tree chapter to another would also take time.

This is the best fix we can think of so far, but our technical director is still experimenting/thinking of ways on how to improve the player experience.

[h1] Branching Tree Nodes not unlocking [/h1]

Chapters 6 and 7 have 4000 branch tree nodes combined, all of which we are manually unlocking via script. If you find a node that doesn't light up, please let us know ASAP so we can investigate and patch it on our end (please enable the "show debug info" and send us the scene no. + line no.)

Please take note that if you have a save file that has a problematic node, even if we patch it, it still wouldn't be unlocked when you reload it. Instead, you'll have to reload the previous scene that has a working node, and skip the part where your save file is, and then replace that save file. 

[h1] Voice Acting & Epilogues [/h1]

This patch should also fix a couple of errors with voice acting. We are aware that some lines are still unvoiced, and they will be patched soon as well!

Any problems regarding the Epilogues should also be fixed now! Otherwise, please let us know!

[h1] Avatars for everyone!! [/h1]

Phew, thank you for reading this far! We deeply apologize for any inconvenience, but rest assured we're working hard to fix every error you report as much as we can. (•̀o•́)ง

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28198396/6e8485a5e75dd4e9c91a59223f4faae00aac4815.jpg[/img]

Let's end this update on a lighter note! Here's a The Letter avatar pack for everyone! Time to change your display pictures!! ♡

[url=https://s3-ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/yangyangmobile/The+Letter+Avatar+Pack.zip]https://s3-ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/yangyangmobile/The+Letter+Avatar+Pack.zip[/url]

notes.title: 2 Days to go + Backer Steam Keys sent!
notes.content:
Hello gang!

The wait is almost over! [b] Only 2 days left until #TheLetterVN's full release on Steam! :) [/b] We'd like to thank you all once again for making The Letter a reality!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28198396/25d7293c40706b328e78034094c76a27fb3dd0b9.jpg[/img]

[h1] Steam Keys [/h1]

As of this writing, [b] we have sent out early access Steam keys to everyone who pledged for a copy of the game! [/b] If you haven't received your key, please let us know ASAP so we can sort it out!

Otherwise, we hope you guys will have fun with the visual novel! Don’t forget to let us know what you think by leaving us a review! We’re always excited to hear from you!  

Thank you very much and once again, we would like to welcome all of you to the Ermengarde Mansion! :)

[b] A few reminders: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b] Chapter 5 onwards is still on its beta phase, and we strongly advise against playing these chapters for now (it will be updated soon before launch date!). [/b] Chapters 1-4, on the other hand, are already in their fully playable states and covers 15-20 hours of game time (out of 30-50 hours, depending on reading speed)!

[*] (Related to 1st bullet) Because the build currently uploaded on Steam is still the beta version, [b] there's a risk that your save files may be deleted/wiped upon the game's full launch this 24th July, to ensure a clean slate and that it runs smoothly for everyone. [/b] The wipe is not guaranteed as it will largely depend on the seriousness of the bugs we have yet to find on Chapters 5-7, but just a heads-up, nevertheless. We apologize beforehand for any inconvenience!

[*] [b] Please help us improve the game by reporting bugs! [/b] You can post it [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/460430/discussions/0/2119355556476647164/]here,[/url] or you can also message us privately via our social media channels.

[*] [b] DRM-free copies of the game will come months after the launch on Steam. [/b] But rest assured that you will also receive copies of it! Make sure to keep an eye out for another email from us!  

[*] [b] Please be aware that the game touches on mature themes that others may find disturbing, offensive, and/or triggering. [/b] For the full list of our content advisory, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/460430/discussions/0/1457328927831741075/]please click here![/url]

[*] [b]Should you decide to write a piece on it or stream it, feel free to shoot us an email for any questions and we’ll be happy to answer them! Our only request is for live streams and recordings of the game to be uploaded only on or after the 24th, due to the nature of the game. [/b]  
[/list]

[h1] Please support our Thunderclap! [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28198396/d62ad5e6af5d953e345a3694aff867a24279cc6d.png[/img]

If you haven't yet, please join The Letter army by signing up to our [url=thunderclap.it/projects/59113-the-letter-now-out-on-steam]Thunderclap campaign![/url] On the game's release it would automatically blast out the message above on your social media channels, ensuring that more people will be aware! Let's rock the world on the 24th! \o/

Thank you for everything! See you all on the 24th!! ❤
